title: An Interview with a Nurse
text:
Today we talk with Maria, a nurse at a children's hospital. She has worked there for five years. She says she likes her job because she helps children feel better. She works from Monday to Friday.

Maria also talks about her free time. She likes to read books and to walk in the park with her dog. On weekends she often visits her parents in another town. She says that a good night's sleep is very important for her.

questions.text: How long has Maria worked at the hospital?
What does Maria do on weekends?
What kind of person is Maria most likely to be?
options: She is careless about her job
She cares about children and her work
She does not like her patients

questions.text: Why does Maria think sleep is important?
options: Because she wants to win a prize
Because she needs energy for her work
Because she is always tired at school
Because a doctor told her to stop working

vocabulary.definition: a person who looks after sick people in a hospital
a place where sick or injured people receive medical care
the days at the end of the week, Saturday and Sunday
the natural state of rest when a person closes their eyes at night

paragraph_translations: Hoje conversamos com Maria, uma enfermeira de um hospital infantil. Ela trabalha lá há cinco anos. Ela diz que gosta do seu trabalho porque ajuda as crianças a se sentirem melhor. Ela trabalha de segunda a sexta-feira.

Maria também fala sobre o seu tempo livre. Ela gosta de ler livros e de passear no parque com o seu cachorro. Nos fins de semana, ela costuma visitar os pais em outra cidade. Ela diz que um bom sono é muito importante para ela.
